d:
Diwali par ghar mein banayein Peanut Katli — kaju jaisa swaad, sasti moongfali se!
Kam chini, milk powder ka secret, soft katli — poori ghar ki banayi.
bhuni mungaphli se pinat katli banane ka sahi tarika
mungaphli tel na chhore, iske lie phrij aur milk paudar ki trik
kam chini ki sahi nap aur halki tar vali chashni
do banana, belna, vark aur kesar-pista se sajavat
Comment karein — aap Diwali par kaunsi katli banayenge: peanut, kaju, makhana ya badam?
